meaning: The cycle was paused or canceled. Whirlpool says the washer may take 20 to 30 minutes to stop spinning and drain, and shows Int during that time.
causes: Pause or Cancel was pressed during a cycle
The cycle was interrupted and the washer is spinning down and draining
diySteps: Wait while the washer stops spinning and drains. Whirlpool says this can take 20 to 30 minutes
To remove the code, press the Pause or Cancel button twice and the Power button once
If Int is still displayed, unplug the washer or disconnect the power for 5 minutes, then reconnect it
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: Int is a paused or canceled cycle, not a failed part. If it comes back after the 5-minute power disconnect, contact Whirlpool or schedule service online. Int is not LOC, which is Control Lock, and not F5 E2, which is a door that is not locking properly.
sourceTitle: Error Codes in Front Load Washers (Whirlpool Product Help)
